description: Spring MVC and WebFlux: what a project sets in configuration code that decides its routes, and the profile key that declares it instead.

rules.description: RequestMappingHandlerMapping.setPathPrefixes and PathMatchConfigurer.addPathPrefix (in Spring MVC and in WebFlux) serve the controllers a predicate picks under a path prefix. The predicate is a lambda over the controller class and the prefix is often read from a property. This engine reads neither (a prefix written as a constant is readable in principle, and is not read either), so a call to one of them means the routes this pack records may lack their prefix, and the profile's pathPrefixes key is where a project says what they are. A call is this setting when its receiver is declared as the type that declares the method (written in full, or by a name its file imports), or when it is made on a class that extends that type; a receiver declared as another type is another method. A receiver the file does not state (a chain, an untyped lambda parameter) proves nothing, and in a file that imports the type it is said as a lower note, not as the setting. A declared key is taken as the project's word; the call is only said when the key is empty.
rules.why: ruoyi-vue-pro serves every admin controller under /admin-api and every app controller under /app-api, from setPathPrefixes in YudaoWebAutoConfiguration with both values defaulted in WebProperties. Every route was recorded without its prefix, and nothing said why.

params.effect: the controllers it picks are served under a path prefix, and every route of theirs is recorded here without it
